questions.stem_text: If a deviant act is 'normalized', it is:

options.A: recognised as breaking an important norm of behaviour
options.B: seen a temporary aberration from an otherwise 'normal' character
options.C: the first step in establishing a deviant career
options.D: attributed to the person's genetic or anatomical make up

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - seen a temporary aberration from an otherwise 'normal' character

questions.stem_text: The term inter-generational mobility refers to:

options.A: movement into a different occupational category over a person's lifetime
options.B: movement into different occupational categories between generations
options.C: movement into a higher occupational category
options.D: movement into an occupation that generates a lower income

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - movement into different occupational categories between generations

questions.stem_text: Pre-testing a questionnaire is useful for:

options.A: finding out which topics are important to the respondents
options.B: testing out your computer and printer
options.C: identifying any problems with the question wording and routing
options.D: deciding which respondents to leave out of the final sample

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - identifying any problems with the question wording and routing

questions.stem_text: Patterns of drug use in Britain reveal that:

options.A: it has increased and is no longer confined to a hedonistic youth subculture
options.B: the most commonly used recreational drug is Ecstasy
options.C: teenage girls are more likely to experiment with hard drugs than teenage boys
options.D: despite a series of moral panics, the use of illegal drugs is very rare

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - it has increased and is no longer confined to a hedonistic youth subculture
